items.name: Calgary Spring 2027
items.information:
Attendance is not required for the entire competition. However, please arrive at least **15 minutes** before your event's planned start time. Please bring your own puzzles for the events you are competing in.

## First-Time Competitors:
All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) for a basic overview of the rules.

## Notice of Filming and Photography:
Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Wuppertaler Würfel Wochenende 2027
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjMwNzc1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--efff7467f755cf862a58e338598496d0aad69b9b/D8BA8322-C907-471D-B56C-53219F744BBB.png)


**German**


Liebe Cuberinnen und Cuber,

wir freuen uns, euch zum Wuppertaler Würfel-Wochenende am 20. und 21. März 2027 einzuladen!

Nach drei erfolgreichen Wettbewerben im Herbst 2025, Frühjahr 2026 und Herbst 2026 geht unser Würfel-Wochenende in die nächste Runde. 

Auch diesmal heißen wir euch herzlich in Wuppertal willkommen, um gemeinsam ein spannendes Wochenende rund um den Zauberwürfel zu erleben.

Ganz gleich, ob ihr zum ersten Mal an einem offiziellen WCA-Wettbewerb teilnehmt oder bereits erfahrene Cuberinnen und Cuber seid – bei uns sind alle herzlich willkommen!

Freut euch auf spannende Solves, neue persönliche Bestzeiten, jede Menge Spaß und natürlich viele Begegnungen mit der Cubing-Community.

Bitte lest euch vor der Anmeldung alle Informationen auf der Wettbewerbsseite sorgfältig durch.

Wir freuen uns auf euch und ein tolles Würfel-Wochenende in Wuppertal!

**English**

Dear cubers,

We are excited to invite you to the Wuppertal Cubing Weekend on March 20–21, 2027!

Following three successful competitions in autumn 2025, spring 2026, and autumn 2026, we are delighted to welcome you back to Wuppertal for another exciting weekend of speedcubing.

Whether you’re joining your very first official WCA competition or you’re already an experienced competitor, everyone is warmly welcome!

Look forward to exciting solves, new personal bests, lots of fun, and, of course, meeting fellow cubers from the community.

Please make sure to read all information on the competition page carefully before registering.

We can’t wait to see you in Wuppertal for another fantastic cubing weekend!

# Southern Cubing welcomes you to Houston for Southern Championship 2027!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjI0NDg4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4088f7d2630143e19fab65d987da291e927d4f0e/Southerns27Logo.png)

The highest placing resident of Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Oklahoma or Texas in each event at this competition will be recognized as the Southern Champion! Check out the [Southern Championship Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2027#79692-southern-champion-eligibility) tab for more information.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [New Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2027#79691-new-competitor-information-and-faq) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is organized by [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/) and supported by our [sponsors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2027#79698-sponsors-and-partners).

venue.name: The Commons
venue.details: Nugent-Custer Performance Hall on the 2nd floor

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA4MTk5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--eb570dfb9a740dbc378bc5fdfa55473c8cbdb768/Untitled%20-%20July%2025,%202026%20at%2008.35.43.png)
Competitors may bring in outside food & non alcoholic beverages.  There will not be any on site concessions available.  

The venue features a free indoor playground on the first floor for families.  There is a moving sculpture that runs in the lobby and can also be viewed from the competition floor.  

The venue is 100% ADA Accessible with elevators, escalators & stage ramps.  

The street parking and parking garage next door are all FREE on weekends.

Across the street from the venue you can find a Children's museum, Historical Ice Cream Parlor/Museum and various other stores & eateries.  There are chain restaurants scattered around the city.

Lodging:

The Hotel Indigo is just down from the venue and recently renovated.  Near the interstate are other hotel chain options.



This competition is being supported by Midwest Cubing Association.
